capabilities: log meditation sessions into the daily note under a configurable heading
pre-fill wave, track, and focus level from the previous session parsed out of the note
fill in focus level automatically from a built-in track catalogue
insert an embedded logger button via a code fence, for example in a daily-note template
open the logger from ribbon, command palette, context menu, URI link, or status bar
disambiguation: Not a file-syncing tool; Hemi-Sync names the Monroe Institute audio technique whose sessions the plugin logs.
extras: Not yet in the community catalog; install via BRAT or from release files. README states the plugin is unaffiliated with The Monroe Institute, ships no audio, and makes no network requests.
motivation: The author states that nothing else filled in session numbers and focus levels from the note itself, so the plugin had to exist.
problem: Logging Gateway tape sessions in a daily note means manually scrolling to a heading, counting session numbers, recalling the previous track, and typing focus levels every time.
summary: Meditation session logger that appends pre-filled Hemi-Sync and Gateway Experience session entries to your daily note from wave, track, and focus pickers.
